mandatory_signature: Long low horizontal upper body/barrel, several hand widths long; never a short square toy blaster
Distinct angular wedge/sloping nose and continuous barrel profile
Dark navy main mass with narrow cyan/blue inset panels; no predominantly white receiver or orange window
Rear/underslung dark pistol grip connected coherently to trigger hand; weapon body extends forward well beyond hand
Consistent complete barrel length/hand junction across guard, raise, aim, emission and return
Opaque contiguous silhouette; no generic pistol substituted because gun is small at SMS size
forbidden_regressions: Short white/blue compact blaster from individualconceptv4/sourcev1
Changing gun trajectory/silhouette to hide SAT overflow
Truncating barrel, shortening only action frame, dropping character sprites or shrinking wide pose individually
authoring_implications: Keep elbow folded and grip closer to torso to stage a long barrel within a narrow horizontal envelope
A short one-emission pulse may leave view between sampled drawings; no invented projectile lifespan required
Freeze weapon authority before source and conversion; inspect terminal and grip at native target size
validation: Inspect shape against exact user reference and approved harmony; ratio alone is not semantic fidelity
Re-measure complete pair in both faces after changed pixels
Independent source/SMS review and owner judgment remain distinct from byte/palette gates
